name: M20 threaded rod hand jack, 500 kg
purpose: A jack built from hardware: M20 class 4.6 all-thread through a standard steel hex nut, cranked by a 250 mm bar. Works, and self-locks with a wide margin because the 60 degree flank and the short lead both push that way. Two things the tool has to say: it is a fastener thread being used for motion, and an 18 mm hex nut is shorter than one pitch diameter, which is the argument for a coupling nut.
